name: Gathering Materials
summary: In the Undercity, Anastasia Hartwell sends aspiring Horde mages to Silverpine Forest for Dalaran mana gems. They also need linen to make their first true mage's robes.

sections.title: A Rite of Arcane Standing
sections.body: Undercity initiates gather the materials for their first true robes: a bolt of simple linen and potent Dalaran mana gems. The robes mark their station and personal worth, and Anastasia Hartwell directs the novices to harvest these raw components for an enchanted weave.

sections.title: Pragmatism of the Forsaken
sections.body: The mana gems cannot be bought or conjured. Dalaran mages are stationed across Silverpine Forest, especially near Ambermill, and the gems must be taken from them. Anastasia Hartwell says Dalaran's arcane philosophies mirror those of the Forsaken, but sentiment has no place in the Undercity. To the Forsaken, wizards too weak to defend their relics forfeit both their treasures and their lives.

sections.title: The Tailor of the Magic Quarter
sections.body: Josef Gregorian, a tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, receives the gathered cloth and gems. He admits he lacks the magical talent to judge the pristine quality of Dalaran's enchanted stones, but he has the rare artisan skill to weave their raw power into the robes.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Gathering Materials?
faq.answer: The rite initiates Horde mages into their first formal enchanted robes. The linen and mana gems go to tailor Josef Gregorian, who uses them to craft the robes.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia Hartwell send you after Dalaran mages?
faq.answer: Dalaran wizards stationed across Silverpine Forest carry refined mana gems that channel strong magical currents. Anastasia Hartwell sees their shared arcane philosophies, but believes weakness in the field forfeits their lives and resources to the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where are the Dalaran wizards located?
aliases: where to find dalaran mana gems
faq.answer: Dalaran wizards are stationed across Silverpine Forest, particularly near Ambermill and around the grounds southeast of the Sepulcher.

aliases: who is the tailor in magic quarter
faq.answer: Josef Gregorian is an Undead tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. Though he is no arcane spellcaster, he specializes in stitching enchanted garments like spellfire robes.

faq.q: What robes are crafted from these materials?
faq.answer: Josef Gregorian uses the linen and Dalaran mana gems to stitch Spellfire Robes, a classic garment that marks an apprentice's passage into an established mage.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia find killing Dalaran mages somewhat distasteful?
faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell finds the killing distasteful because Dalaran mages share many arcane beliefs and philosophies with Forsaken mages. Still, survival and necessity outweigh sentiment.

angles.text: As a Horde mage, you reach a milestone when you leave simple apprentice attire for tailored robes woven with captured arcane power.
As an Undead, you see the Forsaken's ruthless outlook: shared arcane philosophies with Dalaran's sorcerers bring no mercy when those wizards prove too weak to hold Silverpine.
As a tailor, you bind mundane linen cloth with potent mana gems to make enduring enchanted garments.
